prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” attorney for every car-accident case — the best lawyer for you depends on the facts of your crash, the severity of injuries, whether the case will settle or go to trial, and how comfortable you are with the lawyer. I can help find attorneys near you if you tell me your neighborhood or zip code. 

How to find the best personal-injury lawyer for your car-accident claim
- Look for plaintiff-side experience in car-accident cases (not defense work).  
- Track record: past settlements/verdicts for similar injuries and whether they try cases when insurers won’t pay.  
- Trial experience and resources (investigators, medical experts).  
- Good communicator: returns calls, explains strategy and fees.  
- Works contingency (no fee unless you recover) and is clear about costs/expenses.  
- Check independent ratings/reviews: Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, Avvo, Google reviews, and state bar discipline records.  
- Ask specific questions in a free consult: estimated value range, expected timeline, who will handle the file, and typical fees/expenses.

Well-known Chicago plaintiff firms you can start with
- Clifford Law Offices — nationally known Chicago personal-injury/wrongful-death practice.  
- Levin & Perconti — longtime Chicago personal-injury firm with many high-value recoveries.  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard — focuses on serious- injury car-accident claims.  
- Goldberg Weisman Cairo — Chicago plaintiffs’ personal-injury firm handling auto crash cases.  
- Power Rogers & Smith (or similar local plaintiff firms) — some firms specialize in heavier litigation and trial work.

(These are examples to start your search — it’s worth speaking with a few firms to see who’s the best match for your case.)

If you’d like, tell me:
- Your zip code or neighborhood,  
- A brief summary of the accident and injuries, and  
- Whether you prefer a big-name trial firm or a smaller lawyer who may give more personal attention —

and I’ll pull a tailored short list of reputable Chicago attorneys with contact info and tips on what to ask in the free consultation.
